paragraphs.text: Kelly Digges is a former Magic designer, developer and creative designer for Wizards of the Coast .

Digges used to be a writer for StarCityGames and an editor for the Pro Tour coverage team. He started coverage editing as a contractor in July 2006 and became a full-time editor in November 2006. Digges replaced Ted Knutson as editor for magicthegathering.com . The position had a greater focus on copyediting than it did during Knutson's tenure. While serving as the editor-in-chief for the website, he dipped his toe into Magic R&D and in 2011 he shifted over to full-time R&D (half editing, half playtesting ). In 2014, he switched roles again and became a member of the Creative team under Jenna Helland . He left the company in April 2018.
